# Menu icons

Most icons in `assets/icons/` are original to CRT XR: drafted by
`scripts/make-pixel-icons.gd` from the menus' own drawings, or drawn by hand.

Fifteen row icons, the D-pad glyph and the pointer are tiles from Kenney's **1-Bit Pack** (version 1.2), by
Kenney (www.kenney.nl), under Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0; licence text in
`Kenney-1-Bit-Pack-License.txt`). Credit is not required; it is given here.
They are taken from `Tilesheet/monochrome-transparent_packed.png` (16×16
tiles, row,column) and recoloured to white for tinting, otherwise unchanged:

| Icon | Tile |
|---|---|
| `menu/music.png` | 16,39 |
| `menu/home.png` | 16,41 |
| `menu/save.png` | 16,42 |
| `menu/gear.png` | 16,45 |
| `menu/up.png` | 13,24 |
| `menu/clear.png` | 13,40 |
| `menu/video.png` | 10,17 |
| `glyphs/dpad.png` | 10,43 |
| `menu/gamepad.png` | 15,31 |
| `menu/help.png` | 13,38 |
| `menu/audio.png` | 16,38 |
| `menu/scan.png` | 12,40 |
| `menu/view.png` | 14,24 |
| `menu/fit.png` | 16,46 |
| `menu/warn.png` | 21,38 |

| `glyphs/dpad-up.png`, `-right`, `-down`, `-left` | each arm of 10,44 to 10,47, less the cross of 10,43 |

* SHA-256 of the download: `129a0e74e1dc9091a769d5118be5c88780484c7a3771ee33ac9ef0df02583a9a`

## Console icons by Tatohead

Fourteen console icons in `assets/icons/consoles/` are from **Console-Iconset**
by Tatohead (https://github.com/Tatohead/Console-Iconset), used unmodified at
their native 32×32 and drawn at twice their size.

The project has no licence file. Its README grants use with credit, in these
words (retrieved 30 October 2026 at commit
`4b5bdbfd21f3ccfe104f3973209cfae80ccf9087`):

> However, feel free to use these icons in projects. All I request is that you
> give credit.

Credit: console icons by Tatohead, https://github.com/Tatohead/Console-Iconset.

original to CRT XR. The icons depict the consoles' hardware; console names,
logos and designs are trademarks of their owners.
